Gaussian Log-Likelihood Gradient

Source: R/precision.R
ldgm_gaussian_likelihood_gradient.Rd

Initial R port of GraphLD's gaussian_likelihood_gradient().

Usage

ldgm_gaussian_likelihood_gradient(
  pz,
  precision,
  del_M_del_a = NULL,
  diagonal_method = "exact",
  n_samples = 100L,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

pz

Numeric vector of precision-premultiplied GWAS summary statistics.

precision

Sparse precision matrix or ldgm_precision object.

del_M_del_a

Optional matrix of derivatives of diagonal elements with respect to model parameters.

diagonal_method

Inverse-diagonal method passed to ldgm_inverse_diagonal().

n_samples

Number of stochastic probes for "xdiag", "xnys", or "hutchinson".

seed

Optional random seed for stochastic probes.

Value

Node-level gradient vector, or parameter gradient if del_M_del_a is supplied.
